hero.title: Retirement Plan Consulting
hero.subtitle: Independent retirement plan consulting for your organization and its employees.

blocks.text: Managing a retirement plan involves important fiduciary, investment, provider, plan-design, and participant decisions. PointOak partners with business owners, executives, HR leaders, and retirement-plan committees to provide independent retirement plan consulting and ongoing fiduciary support.

body.text: PointOak brings deep retirement-plan experience to plan sponsors, with founder Darsh Makim, CRPC®, advising retirement plan sponsors since 2005.

As an independent, fee-only registered investment adviser, we aren't affiliated with recordkeepers or investment providers. We provide advice within our fiduciary role, with the interests of the plan and its participants at the center of our analysis.

Your retirement plan isn't something you review once a year. We become an extension of your team, providing ongoing guidance, proactive recommendations, and responsive support whenever questions arise.

blocks.text: Managing a retirement plan involves much more than selecting investments. Every decision—from fiduciary oversight and provider selection to participant education and plan design—affects your employees, your compliance obligations, and your company's long-term success.

blocks.text: PointOak works alongside plan sponsors to coordinate governance, investments, provider reviews, plan design, and participant support.

body.text: Help employees understand their retirement benefits and give them direct access to experienced financial guidance. PointOak provides group education, customized communications, financial wellness programs, and complimentary 30-minute individual consultations that employees can schedule directly with a PointOak advisor.

We help plan sponsors support their fiduciary responsibilities through investment advice, committee governance, ongoing investment oversight, and documentation. The scope of PointOak's fiduciary role is defined by the engagement.

Your retirement plan should remain competitive as providers, fees, and regulations evolve. We benchmark your plan using your actual plan data—not industry averages—to evaluate fees, services, investments, and provider performance, giving you the information you need to make confident decisions.

PointOak combines investment analysis, ongoing monitoring, and recommendations documented within the plan's investment-review process. The menu, managers, costs, and default investment are considered together.
Evaluate target date funds through selection and suitability analysis, glide path review, fees, structure, participant demographics, and ongoing monitoring.

PointOak helps evaluate plan features and industry benchmarks in the context of the organization's objectives and workforce, coordinating implementation with the recordkeeper, TPA, and legal counsel when appropriate.
